notes: Corrected: the copula were of the trumpeters and singers were as one was placed on כְּ under rule 49; that rule supplies a copula from the construction for a verbless clause, and this clause writes יְהִי, which the ASV realizes both as the frame and as that copula. Both realizations go to הָיָה (rule 25), and כְּ keeps as.
Variant WLC.2CH.5.13.v002 (s005–s007) is underdetermined with the base reading retained and compatible with the ASV; no fallback exclusion arises (rule 53).
ASV margin offers for song for כלי השיר; printed instruments of music is aligned (rule 38).
